reason: Iteration 0 is not yet satisfactory because it violates key task requirements and contains several high-impact modeling mismatches. Critical issues include missing regime-separated experimental settings (2019→2019, 2021→2021, 2019→2021 OOD) and the fact that the LLM generator path is not actually used for the evaluated trajectories. Additionally, time modeling (dwell vs travel double-counting) and category semantics inconsistencies are likely to materially inflate SI/DARD/STVD/SD JSD. There is substantial potential for improvement within the remaining iterations (max=3), and we are early in the iteration budget.

specific_areas: Implement regime-separated experimental settings with explicit CLI flag and date filtering; enforce 2019→2021 as true OOD (fit on 2019–2020, validate on 2021)
Make --generator=llm produce ALL evaluated rollouts (not a side artifact); parse LLM outputs back into DayTrajectory and evaluate those; add robust validation/retry/fallback logic
Fix time feasibility: remove dwell/travel double-counting by fitting dwell on (gap - estimated_travel) residuals OR by not adding travel when dwell already represents the full gap
Unify category semantics: store fine-grained/base place_type in simulated events and rely on catto.json mapping during evaluation; prefer POI catalog lookup by poi_id during training
Calibration correctness: ensure calibrator simulates and evaluates the exact same agent-date set (optionally per-agent averaging) to avoid mismatch/noise
Destination candidate sets: introduce spatial locality (nearest-within-radius) + neighbor mix + small exploration to reduce SD/STVD tails

task_understanding.adjustments: Treat regime settings and LLM-based generation as hard requirements (must affect the evaluated outputs), not optional features. Ensure the pipeline supports the three experimental protocols explicitly.

data_analysis.adjustments: Add checks/summary stats by year/regime (counts of trajectories per year, per-agent coverage) to confirm filtering/splits are correct and to detect leakage or empty validation sets.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize fixing the time model (dwell/travel decomposition) and category-label consistency before more complex behavioral modeling; these are foundational and impact multiple metrics.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement setting-aware filtering/splitting utilities, integrate LLM generator into the main generation/evaluation path, and refactor Event fields to keep fine-grained place_type while using coarse categories internally as needed.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit/integration tests for: (1) setting splits (2019/2021/OOD), (2) LLM output parsing/validation, (3) place_type mapping consistency, (4) dwell residual computation not going negative and respecting bounds.

simulation_execution.adjustments: ACE mode skips execution; no changes here beyond ensuring the pipeline is runnable locally with a deterministic seed once enabled.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Evaluate metrics separately per setting (2019→2019, 2021→2021, 2019→2021) and report per-metric JSD plus aggregate; ensure calibration is evaluated on matched agent-date sets.

feedback_generation.adjustments: In the next iteration, focus feedback on whether the two spec-blockers (regime protocol + LLM-evaluated outputs) are fully resolved, then on whether SI and category-based metrics improved after time/category fixes.
